findings.claim: Two daily-active regional manager users left the company in the last month; their seats have not been reassigned or backfilled.
Overall platform usage likely declined this month as a result of the departed users, though aggregate login data was not available for this review.
The CFO now requires visibility on any renewal or spend decision over six figures, a new approval layer introduced after a recent acquisition.
No current mapping exists of who at Northwind owns the decision to onboard the newly acquired entity onto the platform.
Renewal is due in 70 days. The CSM proactively opened the renewal conversation at this checkpoint, ahead of the customer.
The CFO's new spend-visibility requirement could slow renewal approval versus prior cycles, though the CFO has not yet reviewed a proposal.
A health score of 58/100 is consistent with a recent adoption dip from the departed users rather than a deeper product dissatisfaction signal, based on available context.

The acquisition likely represents incremental ARR if the second entity onboards, though deal size has not been estimated or scoped yet.
